text:
Priya: Quick sync — final push for tomorrow's release. Target deploy window: 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC. Who's on deploy? I'll be available for rollout coordination and post-deploy checks.
Dan: I can own the deploy step (run the promotion, monitor logs). Planning to start the canary at +0 and full at +15m if no errors.
Olivia: QA_Alex and I will run smoke and core flows right after canary. Smoke checklist below — will post results in this thread.
QA_Alex: Got it — I'll run the checklist after canary is green. ETA ~10m.
Priya: CS_Team — please prep the customer-facing notes (short bullet points + known limitations). MarketingOps — we need the banner copy and blog draft links.
CS_Team: On it. We'll have the support KB + canned replies ready before deploy (about 30m prior).
MarketingOps: Draft blog link will be in #marketing by EOD today. We'll hold until deploy is confirmed.
Miguel: Quick question on rollback — are we doing full revert to previous model bundle or using graceful fallback to smaller instance? I can automate either but need the exact command.
Priya: Prefer graceful fallback to model-v2-small first, then full revert if issues persist beyond 10m. Dan — can you keep the revert commands handy?
Dan: Yep. Revert plan: 1) route 100% to model-v2-small (route table update), 2) if errors persist, promote previous release tag. Commands I'm using:
```
# switch routing table
redwoodctl route update --service inference --to model-v2-small --env prod
# promote previous release
redwoodctl release promote --tag v2.4.9 --env prod
```
I'll paste the exact commands in the deploy doc before start.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for release v2.5.0 set for 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z. Notifying on-call.
Priya: On-call, please watch latency dashboards for the first 15 minutes for any regression >20% and error rate spikes >1%. Tag me if thresholds hit.
QA_Alex: Smoke checklist (short):
1) basic text-gen end-to-end (happy path)
2) chat session restore (KV cache)
3) embeddings endpoint health + sample embed sanity
4) billing and quota endpoint responses
I'll report with pass/fail for each item.
Priya: Perfect. If all smoke passes, we'll update CS and MarketingOps to proceed with external comms.
CS_Team: We'll queue the notify email; hold send until you confirm.
MarketingOps: Banner and release notes ready in draft — ping us when you want publish. :rocket:
Dan: I'll start the canary at T0 and post logs link here. If anything odd, I'll abort and execute fallback plan.
Olivia: If anything looks flaky in the first 5m, flag and we'll rollback.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Final: deploy owners = Dan (execution), Priya (coord), Olivia/QA_Alex (smoke), Miguel (rollback automation). Leaving notes in the release doc and will check in 30m.
Miguel: I'll be on standby for rollback automation.
Priya: Closing the loop — posting the release doc link: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.5.0 (will update commands live).
Dan: Copy. See you at T-5.
Priya: :thumbsup:
